items.criterion: Use Google Scholar without signing in and handle access blocks appropriately
items.description: Attempt the task on Google Scholar (starting from scholar.google.com) without signing in. Full credit if the agent proceeds without login OR if at any point a CAPTCHA/access block/robot check prevents progress and the agent stops and records the block (with no bypassing and no automated CAPTCHA solving). Partial credit if Scholar is used but it’s unclear whether sign-in was avoided or the block is not clearly documented. No credit if the agent signs in, claims to bypass CAPTCHA, or fabricates results despite a visible block.

items.criterion: Record the original Google Scholar citation count for 'Attention Is All You Need'
items.description: Find the correct Google Scholar record for ‘Attention Is All You Need’ and record its main ‘Cited by N’ count. Full credit for the correct citation count tied to an unambiguous record (title matches; ideally the Vaswani et al. 2017 entry). If multiple versions/records are shown, full credit if the agent clearly indicates which record was used (e.g., the primary/most-cited one) and reports that citation count. If blocked by CAPTCHA/access restrictions before the citation count can be viewed, award full credit if the agent clearly reports the block and inability to retrieve the count.

items.criterion: Open 'Cited by' results and apply date filter to 2024 onward
items.description: Open the paper’s ‘Cited by’ results and restrict citing results to 2024 onward (e.g., custom range start year 2024). Full credit if the filter is applied and the agent states that 2024+ is active. If Scholar blocks access or the date filter UI is unavailable/doesn’t load, full credit if the agent documents the issue and stops per constraints. Partial credit if the agent reaches citing results but the filter is unclear or slightly misapplied while attempting to set 2024.

items.criterion: Most-cited citing paper (2024+): title, authors, citation count
items.description: From the 2024+ filtered citing-results list, report the most-cited citing paper with title, authors, and its ‘Cited by’ count as shown. Full credit if the agent sorts by citations when available (or otherwise uses the highest citation count visible) and reports all three fields. If multiple items are tied for highest citations, any tied item is acceptable with an explanation. If access is blocked after filtering (preventing identification of top citing papers), award full credit if the agent reports the block and provides no fabricated paper details.

items.criterion: Second most-cited citing paper (2024+): title, authors, citation count
items.description: Report the second most-cited citing paper under the 2024+ filter with title, authors, and citation count. Full credit if rank ordering is supported by ‘sort by citations’ or by the visible citation counts. If ties make ordering ambiguous, any reasonable selection among the next-highest tied items is acceptable with a note. If blocked after filtering, award full credit if the agent reports the block and does not fabricate details.

items.criterion: Third most-cited citing paper (2024+): title, authors, citation count
items.description: Report the third most-cited citing paper under the 2024+ filter with title, authors, and citation count. Full credit if rank ordering is supported by ‘sort by citations’ or by the visible citation counts. If ties make ordering ambiguous, any reasonable selection among the next-highest tied items is acceptable with a note. If blocked after filtering, award full credit if the agent reports the block and does not fabricate details.

items.criterion: Respect stopping condition (no extra records beyond what is requested)
items.description: Stop after recording: (1) the original citation count, (2) the 2024+ date filter application (or inability due to block), and (3) exactly three citing-paper records if accessible. Full credit if the agent does not report additional citing-paper records beyond the three requested. Partial credit if minor extra navigation occurs but no extra citing-paper records are reported. No credit if the agent reports many extra citing-paper records beyond the requested three.
